operations.old: “How a man taking six impairing medications was permitted to navigate a 68,000-ton vessel through dense fog beneath one of America’s busiest bridges is deeply alarming,” stated then-acting NTSB Chairman Mark V. Rosenker.
operations.new: “How a man who was taking a half-dozen impairing prescription medications got to stand on the bridge of a 68,000-ton ship and give directions to guide the vessel through a foggy bay and under a busy highway bridge is very troubling,” said acting NTSB Chairman Mark V. Rosenker.
